<script>
const exerciceId = {{ exercice.id }};

// Ajouter une question (AJAX avec FormData pour l'image)
document.getElementById('question-form').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const texte = document.getElementById('question-texte').value.trim();
    const reponses = document.getElementById('question-reponses').value.trim();
    
    if (!texte) return alert('Veuillez saisir une question');
    if (!reponses) return alert('Veuillez saisir au moins une réponse acceptée');
    
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('texte', texte);
    formData.append('reponses_acceptees', reponses);
    formData.append('points', document.getElementById('question-points').value || 1);
    formData.append('sensible_casse', document.getElementById('question-sensible-casse').checked ? 'on' : '');
    formData.append('explication', document.getElementById('question-explication').value);
    
    const imageInput = document.getElementById('question-image');
    if (imageInput.files.length > 0) {
        formData.append('image', imageInput.files[0]);
    }
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/reponse_courte/ajouter/${exerciceId}/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value },
            body: formData
        });
        
        if (response.ok) {
            location.reload();
        } else {
            const err = await response.json();
            alert('Erreur: ' + (err.error || 'Erreur serveur'));
        }
    } catch (err) {
        alert('Erreur réseau');
    }
});

// Supprimer une question
document.querySelectorAll('.delete-question-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!confirm('Supprimer cette question ?')) return;
        const qId = btn.dataset.questionId;
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`/reponse_courte/supprimer/${exerciceId}/${qId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value }
            });
            if (response.ok) location.reload();
            else alert('Erreur');
        } catch (err) {}
    });
});

// Éditer une question
document.querySelectorAll('.edit-question-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const qId = btn.dataset.questionId;
        const card = document.getElementById(`question-${qId}`);
        
        document.getElementById('edit-question-id').value = qId;
        document.getElementById('edit-texte').value = card.querySelector('.fw-medium')?.textContent.trim() || '';
        document.getElementById('edit-points').value = card.querySelector('.badge.bg-info')?.textContent.replace('pts', '').trim() || 1;
        
        // Récupérer les réponses acceptées
        const reponses = [];
        card.querySelectorAll('.badge-reponse').forEach(badge => {
            reponses.push(badge.textContent.trim());
        });
        document.getElementById('edit-reponses').value = reponses.join('\n');
        
        // Sensible à la casse
        const sensibleCasse = card.querySelector('.badge-warning') !== null;
        document.getElementById('edit-sensible-casse').checked = sensibleCasse;
        
        const explicationSpan = card.querySelector('.fa-lightbulb')?.closest('div')?.querySelector('em');
        document.getElementById('edit-explication').value = explicationSpan?.textContent || '';
        
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('editModal')).show();
    });
});

// Sauvegarder l'édition
document.getElementById('save-edit').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const qId = document.getElementById('edit-question-id').value;
    const texte = document.getElementById('edit-texte').value.trim();
    const reponses = document.getElementById('edit-reponses').value.trim();
    const points = parseInt(document.getElementById('edit-points').value) || 1;
    const sensibleCasse = document.getElementById('edit-sensible-casse').checked;
    const explication = document.getElementById('edit-explication').value;
    
    if (!texte || !reponses) return alert('Question et réponses requises');
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/reponse_courte/modifier/${qId}/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ 
                texte, 
                reponses_acceptees: reponses, 
                points, 
                sensible_casse: sensibleCasse, 
                explication 
            })
        });
        
        if (response.ok) location.reload();
        else alert('Erreur');
    } catch (err) {}
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
// Timer
let timeLeft = {{ temps_restant|default:exercice.duree }} * 60;
const timerElement = document.getElementById('timer');

function updateTimer() {
    const minutes = Math.floor(timeLeft / 60);
    const seconds = timeLeft % 60;
    timerElement.textContent = `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    
    if (timeLeft <= 60) {
        timerElement.classList.add('warning');
    }
    
    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
        clearInterval(timerInterval);
        alert('Temps écoulé ! Soumission automatique...');
        document.getElementById('exercice-form').submit();
    }
    timeLeft--;
}

const timerInterval = setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);

// Navigation entre questions
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-question').forEach(nav => {
    nav.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = parseInt(nav.dataset.index);
        const questionElement = document.getElementById(`question-${index}`);
        if (questionElement) {
            questionElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }
    });
});

// Mettre à jour le statut des questions
function updateQuestionStatus() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.question-container').forEach((container, idx) => {
        const input = container.querySelector('.reponse-courte-input');
        const nav = document.querySelector(`.nav-question[data-index="${idx}"]`);
        if (nav && input) {
            if (input.value.trim().length > 0) {
                nav.classList.add('answered');
            } else {
                nav.classList.remove('answered');
            }
        }
    });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.reponse-courte-input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', updateQuestionStatus);
});
updateQuestionStatus();

// Sauvegarde automatique
let saveTimeout;
function autoSave() {
    clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
    saveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        const reponses = {};
        document.querySelectorAll('.reponse-courte-input').forEach(input => {
            const name = input.getAttribute('name');
            reponses[name] = input.value;
        });
        
        fetch("{% url 'exercice_sauvegarder' exercice.id %}", {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ reponses: reponses })
        }).then(() => {
            $('#saved-indicator').fadeIn(200).delay(1500).fadeOut(500);
        });
    }, 2000);
}

document.querySelectorAll('.reponse-courte-input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', autoSave);
});

// Sauvegarde manuelle
document.getElementById('save-draft').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const reponses = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('.reponse-courte-input').forEach(input => {
        const name = input.getAttribute('name');
        reponses[name] = input.value;
    });
    
    fetch("{% url 'exercice_sauvegarder' exercice.id %}", {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reponses: reponses })
    }).then(() => {
        $('#saved-indicator').fadeIn(200).delay(2000).fadeOut(500);
        alert('Brouillon sauvegardé !');
    });
});

// Restaurer sauvegarde
{% if sauvegarde %}
const savedData = {{ sauvegarde|safe }};
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(savedData)) {
    const input = document.querySelector(`[name="${key}"]`);
    if (input) input.value = value;
}
updateQuestionStatus();
{% endif %}

        e.preventDefault();
    }
});

<script>
// Prévisualisation
document.getElementById('preview-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const texte = document.getElementById('texte-brut').value;
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch("{% url 'texte_trous_previsualiser' %}", {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ texte_brut: texte })
        });
        
        if (response.ok) {
            const data = await response.json();
            const container = document.getElementById('preview-container');
            const content = document.getElementById('preview-content');
            
            content.innerHTML = data.rendu_html || texte;
            container.style.display = 'block';
        }
    } catch (err) {
        alert('Erreur de prévisualisation');
    }
});

// Auto-prévisualisation après modification
document.getElementById('texte-brut').addEventListener('input', () => {
    document.getElementById('preview-container').style.display = 'none';
});
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
// Timer
let timeLeft = {{ temps_restant|default:exercice.duree }} * 60;
const timerElement = document.getElementById('timer');

function updateTimer() {
    const minutes = Math.floor(timeLeft / 60);
    const seconds = timeLeft % 60;
    timerElement.textContent = `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    
    if (timeLeft <= 60) {
        timerElement.classList.add('warning');
    }
    
    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
        clearInterval(timerInterval);
        alert('Temps écoulé ! Soumission automatique...');
        document.getElementById('exercice-form').submit();
    }
    timeLeft--;
}

const timerInterval = setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);

// Navigation entre trous
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-trou').forEach(nav => {
    nav.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const numero = nav.dataset.numero;
        const input = document.getElementById(`trou-${numero}`);
        if (input) {
            input.focus();
            input.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }
    });
});

// Mettre à jour le statut des trous
function updateTrouStatus() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.trou-input').forEach(input => {
        const numero = input.dataset.numero;
        const nav = document.querySelector(`.nav-trou[data-numero="${numero}"]`);
        if (nav) {
            if (input.value.trim().length > 0) {
                nav.classList.add('filled');
                nav.classList.remove('empty');
            } else {
                nav.classList.remove('filled');
                nav.classList.add('empty');
            }
        }
    });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.trou-input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', updateTrouStatus);
});
updateTrouStatus();

// Sauvegarde automatique
let saveTimeout;
function autoSave() {
    clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
    saveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        const reponses = {};
        document.querySelectorAll('.trou-input').forEach(input => {
            reponses[`trou_${input.dataset.numero}`] = input.value;
        });
        
        fetch("{% url 'exercice_sauvegarder' exercice.id %}", {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ reponses: reponses })
        }).then(() => {
            $('#saved-indicator').fadeIn(200).delay(1500).fadeOut(500);
        });
    }, 2000);
}

document.querySelectorAll('.trou-input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', autoSave);
});

// Sauvegarde manuelle
document.getElementById('save-draft').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const reponses = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('.trou-input').forEach(input => {
        reponses[`trou_${input.dataset.numero}`] = input.value;
    });
    
    fetch("{% url 'exercice_sauvegarder' exercice.id %}", {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token }}'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reponses: reponses })
    }).then(() => {
        $('#saved-indicator').fadeIn(200).delay(2000).fadeOut(500);
        alert('Brouillon sauvegardé !');
    });
});

// Restaurer sauvegarde
{% if sauvegarde %}
const savedData = {{ sauvegarde|safe }};
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(savedData)) {
    if (key.startsWith('trou_')) {
        const input = document.querySelector(`[name="${key}"]`);
        if (input) input.value = value;
    }
}
updateTrouStatus();
{% endif %}

// Confirmation avant soumission
document.getElementById('submit-btn').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!confirm('Êtes-vous sûr de vouloir soumettre ? Vous ne pourrez plus modifier vos réponses.')) {
        e.preventDefault();
    }
});
</script>

<script>
const exerciceId = {{ exercice.id }};

// Ajouter une affirmation (AJAX)
document.getElementById('question-form').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const texte = document.getElementById('question-texte').value.trim();
    if (!texte) return alert('Veuillez saisir une affirmation');
    
    const estVrai = document.querySelector('input[name="est_vrai"]:checked')?.value === 'true';
    const points = parseInt(document.getElementById('question-points').value) || 1;
    const explication = document.getElementById('question-explication').value;
    
    const data = {
        texte: texte,
        est_vrai: estVrai,
        points: points,
        explication: explication
    };
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/vrai_faux/ajouter/${exerciceId}/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });
        
        if (response.ok) {
            location.reload();
        } else {
            const err = await response.json();
            alert('Erreur: ' + (err.error || 'Erreur serveur'));
        }
    } catch (err) {
        alert('Erreur réseau');
    }
});

// Supprimer une affirmation
document.querySelectorAll('.delete-question-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!confirm('Supprimer cette affirmation ?')) return;
        const qId = btn.dataset.questionId;
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`/vrai_faux/supprimer/${exerciceId}/${qId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value }
            });
            if (response.ok) location.reload();
            else alert('Erreur');
        } catch (err) {}
    });
});

// Éditer une affirmation
document.querySelectorAll('.edit-question-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const qId = btn.dataset.questionId;
        const card = document.getElementById(`question-${qId}`);
        
        document.getElementById('edit-question-id').value = qId;
        document.getElementById('edit-texte').value = card.querySelector('.fw-medium')?.textContent.trim() || '';
        document.getElementById('edit-points').value = card.querySelector('.badge.bg-info')?.textContent.replace('pts', '').trim() || 1;
        
        // Récupérer si c'est Vrai ou Faux
        const badge = card.querySelector('.badge-vrai, .badge-faux');
        const estVrai = badge?.classList.contains('badge-vrai') || false;
        document.querySelector('input[name="edit_est_vrai"][value="true"]').checked = estVrai;
        document.querySelector('input[name="edit_est_vrai"][value="false"]').checked = !estVrai;
        
        const explicationSpan = card.querySelector('.fa-lightbulb')?.closest('div')?.querySelector('em');
        document.getElementById('edit-explication').value = explicationSpan?.textContent || '';
        
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('editModal')).show();
    });
});

// Sauvegarder l'édition
document.getElementById('save-edit').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const qId = document.getElementById('edit-question-id').value;
    const texte = document.getElementById('edit-texte').value.trim();
    const estVrai = document.querySelector('input[name="edit_est_vrai"]:checked')?.value === 'true';
    const points = parseInt(document.getElementById('edit-points').value) || 1;
    const explication = document.getElementById('edit-explication').value;
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/vrai_faux/modifier/${qId}/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ texte, est_vrai: estVrai, points, explication })
        });
        
        if (response.ok) location.reload();
        else alert('Erreur');
    } catch (err) {}
});
</script>

    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

    border: 1px solid #28a745;
    background-color: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.1);
}
.sticky-top {
    top: 20px;
}
</style>

    .dropzone {
        border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 30px;
        text-align: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        background-color: #f8fafc;
    }
    .dropzone:hover, .dropzone.dragover {
        border-color: #0d6efd;
        background-color: #eef2ff;
    }
    .list-group-item {
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .list-group-item:hover {
        background-color: #f8f9fa;
        transform: translateX(5px);
    }
</style>

<script>
    const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone');
    const fileInput = document.getElementById('fichierInput');
    const browseBtn = document.getElementById('browseBtn');
    const fileInfo = document.getElementById('fileInfo');
    const filenameSpan = document.getElementById('filename');
    const filesizeSpan = document.getElementById('filesize');
    
    function formatFileSize(bytes) {
        if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
        const k = 1024;
        const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
        const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
        return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
    }
    
    function handleFile(file) {
        if (file) {
            filenameSpan.textContent = file.name;
            filesizeSpan.textContent = formatFileSize(file.size);
            fileInfo.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
    
    dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
    browseBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); fileInput.click(); });
    
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        if (e.target.files.length) handleFile(e.target.files[0]);
    });
    
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropzone.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
        dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
        const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
        if (file) {
            fileInput.files = e.dataTransfer.files;
            handleFile(file);
        }
    });
    
    // Rafraîchir la page après ajout de fichier pour voir la liste mise à jour
    // Le formulaire POST recharge déjà la page normalement
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
// Stocker les centres d'intérêt sélectionnés
let selectedInterests = [];
let searchTimeout;

// Fonction pour mettre à jour l'affichage des tags sélectionnés
function updateSelectedTags() {
    const container = $('#selected-interests');
    const idsContainer = $('#selected-ids');
    container.empty();
    idsContainer.empty();
    
    if (selectedInterests.length === 0) {
        container.html('<div class="text-muted small">Aucun centre sélectionné. Tapez ci-dessus pour en ajouter.</div>');
        return;
    }
    
    selectedInterests.forEach((interest, index) => {
        container.append(`
            <div class="badge bg-primary p-2" data-index="${index}" data-name="${interest.name}">
                <i class="fas fa-tag me-1"></i>${interest.name}
                <span class="ms-1 remove-interest" style="cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.7;">&times;</span>
            </div>
        `);
        idsContainer.append(`<input type="hidden" name="centres_interet" value="${interest.name}">`);
    });
}

$(document).ready(function() {
    // Recherche en temps réel via DBpedia API
    $('#search-interest').on('input', function() {
        const query = $(this).val().trim();
        
        clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
        
        if (query.length < 2) {
            $('#search-results').hide();
            return;
        }
        
        searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            $.ajax({
                url: "{% url 'rechercher_centres_interet' %}",
                data: { q: query },
                success: function(results) {
                    const resultsContainer = $('#search-results');
                    resultsContainer.empty();
                    
                    if (results.length === 0) {
                        resultsContainer.append(`
                            <div class="list-group-item text-muted">
                                <i class="fas fa-info-circle me-2"></i>
                                Aucun résultat trouvé. Essayez un autre terme.
                            </div>
                        `);
                    } else {
                        results.forEach(item => {
                            const alreadySelected = selectedInterests.some(i => i.name === item.nom);
                            resultsContainer.append(`
                                <div class="list-group-item list-group-item-action ${alreadySelected ? 'disabled' : ''}" 
                                     data-name="${item.nom.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}">
                                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                                        <div>
                                            <strong>${item.nom}</strong>
                                            ${item.description ? `<br><small class="text-muted">${item.description.substring(0, 80)}</small>` : ''}
                                        </div>
                                        ${alreadySelected ? '<span class="badge bg-success"><i class="fas fa-check"></i> Ajouté</span>' : ''}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `);
                        });
                    }
                    resultsContainer.show();
                },
                error: function() {
                    $('#search-results').html(`
                        <div class="list-group-item text-danger">
                            <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>
                            Erreur de connexion. Réessayez plus tard.
                        </div>
                    `).show();
                }
            });
        }, 300);
    });
    
    // Sélection d'un résultat
    $(document).on('click', '.list-group-item-action', function() {
        if ($(this).hasClass('disabled')) return;
        
        const name = $(this).data('name');
        
        if (!selectedInterests.some(i => i.name === name)) {
            selectedInterests.push({ name: name });
            updateSelectedTags();
        }
        
        $('#search-interest').val('');
        $('#search-results').hide();
    });
    
    // Suppression d'un tag
    $(document).on('click', '.remove-interest', function() {
        const name = $(this).closest('.badge').data('name');
        selectedInterests = selectedInterests.filter(i => i.name !== name);
        updateSelectedTags();
    });
    
    // Cacher les résultats quand on clique ailleurs
    $(document).click(function(e) {
        if (!$(e.target).closest('#search-interest, #search-results').length) {
            $('#search-results').hide();
        }
    });
});

// Gestion de la soumission
document.getElementById('formationForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('submitBtn').innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-1"></i>Traitement...';
});
</script>

<style>

    cursor: pointer;
}
.list-group-item-action:hover {
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
}
.list-group-item-action.disabled {
    background-color: #e9ecef;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.6;
}
</style>

{% endblock %}

<script>
// ── Vue grille / liste ──
function setView(view, btn) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('formationsGrid');
  document.querySelectorAll('.fl-view-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  grid.classList.toggle('list-view', view === 'list');
  localStorage.setItem('fl-view', view);
}

// Restaurer la vue au chargement
(function() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('fl-view');
  if (saved === 'list') {
    document.getElementById('formationsGrid')?.classList.add('list-view');
    document.getElementById('btnList')?.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('btnGrid')?.classList.remove('active');
  }
})();

// ── Sidebar mobile ──
function toggleSidebar() {
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('flSidebar');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
  sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
  overlay.classList.toggle('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = sidebar.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
}

// ── Groupes accordéon ──
function toggleGroup(titleEl) {
  titleEl.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const body = titleEl.nextElementSibling;
  body.style.display = titleEl.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'none' : '';
}

// ── Soumettre filtres ──
function submitFiltres() {
  const form = document.getElementById('filtreForm');
  const skeletons = document.getElementById('skeletonGrid');
  const grid = document.getElementById('formationsGrid');
  if (skeletons && grid) {
    grid.style.opacity = '0.3';
    skeletons.style.display = 'grid';
  }
  setTimeout(() => form.submit(), 150);
}

function resetFiltres() {
  const q = document.getElementById('searchInput')?.value || '';
  window.location.href = q ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : '?';
}

function changerTri(val) {
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('tri', val);
  url.searchParams.delete('page');
  window.location.href = url.toString();
}

function clearSearch() {
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.delete('q');
  url.searchParams.delete('page');
  window.location.href = url.toString();
}

// ── Filtrer les checkboxes ──
function filterCheckboxes(input, prefix) {
  const query = input.value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll(`[id^="${prefix}"]`).forEach(item => {
    const label = item.querySelector('.fl-check-label');
    item.style.display = label?.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

// ── Afficher range prix ──
document.querySelectorAll('input[name="prix_type"]').forEach(r => {
  r.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const block = document.getElementById('prix-range-block');
    if (block) block.classList.toggle('d-none', this.value !== 'range');
  });
});

function updateRange() {
  const min = document.getElementById('rangeMin');
  const max = document.getElementById('rangeMax');
  const minLabel = document.getElementById('prix-min-label');
  const maxLabel = document.getElementById('prix-max-label');
  if (min && max && minLabel && maxLabel) {
    minLabel.textContent = parseInt(min.value).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA';
    maxLabel.textContent = parseInt(max.value).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA';
  }
}

// ── Wishlist (favoris) ──
function toggleWishlist(formationId, btn) {
  btn.disabled = true;
  fetch(`/formations/wishlist/toggle/${formationId}/`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCsrf(), 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
    if (data.added) {
      icon.className = 'fas fa-heart';
      btn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
      icon.className = 'far fa-heart';
      btn.classList.remove('active');
    }
  })
  .finally(() => { btn.disabled = false; });
}

function getCsrf() {
  const m = document.cookie.match('(^|;)\\s*csrftoken=([^;]*)');
  return m ? m[2] : '';
}
</script>

<script>
// ── Lire plus/moins description ──
function toggleDesc() {
  const text = document.getElementById('descText');
  const fade = document.getElementById('descFade');
  const btn = document.getElementById('descToggle');
  const expanded = text.classList.toggle('expanded');
  if (fade) fade.classList.toggle('hidden', expanded);
  btn.innerHTML = expanded
    ? '<i class="fas fa-chevron-up me-1"></i>Réduire'
    : '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down me-1"></i>Lire plus';
}

// ── Lancer la vidéo ──
function playVideo(overlay) {
  const video = overlay.previousElementSibling;
  if (video?.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
    overlay.style.display = 'none';
    video.play();
  }
}

// ── Scroll vers vidéo ──
function scrollToVideo() {
  const el = document.querySelector('.fd-video-wrap');
  if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' }); }
}

// ── Copier le lien ──
function copyLink() {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(() => showToast('Lien copié !'));
}

// ── Toast ──
function showToast(msg) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toastMsg');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 2500);
}

// ── Coupon ──
function appliquerCoupon() {
  const code = document.getElementById('couponInput')?.value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById('couponMsg');
  if (!code) return;
  fetch(`/formations/coupon/verifier/?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`, {
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    msg.style.display = 'block';
    if (data.valide) {
      msg.className = 'fd-coupon-msg success';
      msg.textContent = `✓ Coupon valide — ${data.description}`;
      // Mettre à jour le lien d'achat
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnAcheter');
      if (btn) btn.href += `?coupon=${code}`;
    } else {
      msg.className = 'fd-coupon-msg error';
      msg.textContent = `✗ ${data.message || 'Code invalide ou expiré'}`;
    }
  })
  .catch(() => {
    msg.style.display = 'block';
    msg.className = 'fd-coupon-msg error';
    msg.textContent = 'Erreur lors de la vérification.';
  });
}

// ── Essayer aperçu ──
function essayerGratuit() {
  const curr = document.querySelector('.fd-curriculum-item .fd-curr-preview');
  if (curr) curr.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
}

// ── Animer les barres de notes au chargement ──
const barFills = document.querySelectorAll('.fd-rbar-fill');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) {
      e.target.style.width = e.target.getAttribute('style').match(/width:([^;]+)/)?.[1] || '0%';
      observer.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.4 });
barFills.forEach(b => observer.observe(b));
</script>

{% endblock %}

<style>
.stars-input { display:flex; gap:6px; }
.star-label { cursor:pointer; }
.star-icon { font-size:2.2rem; color:#d1d5db; transition:color 0.15s; }
.star-icon.hovered, .star-icon.selected { color:#f59e0b; }
.fw-600 { font-weight:600; }
.fw-700 { font-weight:700; }

<script>
const stars = document.querySelectorAll('.star-icon');
const feedbacks = ['Très mauvais', 'Mauvais', 'Moyen', 'Bien', 'Excellent !'];
const feedbackEl = document.getElementById('starFeedback');
let selectedNote = 0;

stars.forEach(star => {
  const val = parseInt(star.dataset.val);

  star.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
    stars.forEach(s => s.classList.toggle('hovered', parseInt(s.dataset.val) <= val));
    feedbackEl.textContent = feedbacks[val - 1];
  });

  star.parentElement.addEventListener('click', () => {
    selectedNote = val;
    document.querySelector(`input[name="note"][value="${val}"]`).checked = true;
    stars.forEach(s => {
      s.classList.toggle('selected', parseInt(s.dataset.val) <= val);
      s.classList.remove('hovered');
    });
    feedbackEl.textContent = feedbacks[val - 1];
    feedbackEl.style.color = '#f59e0b';
    feedbackEl.style.fontWeight = '600';
  });
});

document.querySelector('.stars-input').addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
  stars.forEach(s => {
    s.classList.remove('hovered');
    s.classList.toggle('selected', parseInt(s.dataset.val) <= selectedNote);
  });
  feedbackEl.textContent = selectedNote ? feedbacks[selectedNote - 1] : 'Cliquez pour noter';
});

document.getElementById('avisForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
  if (!selectedNote) {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert('Veuillez attribuer une note.');
    return;
  }
  const btn = document.getElementById('avisBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Publication...';
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
function showTab(name, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.mf-tab-content').forEach(t => t.classList.add('d-none'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.mf-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-' + name).classList.remove('d-none');
  btn.classList.add('active');
}

function retirerWishlist(formationId, btn) {
  fetch(`/formations/wishlist/toggle/${formationId}/`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCsrf(), 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  })
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    if (!data.added) {
      btn.closest('.mf-card').style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => btn.closest('.mf-card').remove(), 300);
    }
  });
}

function getCsrf() {
  const m = document.cookie.match('(^|;)\\s*csrftoken=([^;]*)');
  return m ? m[2] : '';
}
</script>

<script>
document.getElementById('payForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('payBtn');
  const tel = document.getElementById('telephone').value;
  const methode = document.querySelector('input[name="type_paiement"]:checked');
  const conditions = document.getElementById('conditions').checked;

  if (!methode) {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert('Veuillez choisir un mode de paiement.');
    return;
  }
  if (!tel || tel.length !== 9) {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert('Veuillez entrer un numéro de téléphone valide (9 chiffres).');
    return;
  }
  if (!conditions) {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert('Veuillez accepter les conditions de vente.');
    return;
  }
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Traitement en cours...';
});
</script>

<!-- ══ JAVASCRIPT ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
// Configuration
let dernierMessageId = {{ dernier_message_id|default:0 }};
let pollingActif = document.getElementById('forum-config')?.dataset.pollingActif === 'true';
let intervallePolling = parseInt(document.getElementById('forum-config')?.dataset.intervalle || 15);
let forumId = {{ forum.id }};
let csrfToken = document.getElementById('forum-config')?.dataset.csrfToken || '{{ csrf_token }}';
let timeoutId = null;
let enPause = false;

// Éléments DOM
const messagesContainer = document.getElementById('forum-messages-container');
const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('forum-messages');
const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
const charCount = document.getElementById('charCount');
const maxLength = {{ config.forum_longueur_max_message|default:2000 }};

// Scroll automatique en bas
function scrollToBottom() {
  if (messagesContainer) {
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  }
}
scrollToBottom();

// Compteur de caractères
if (messageInput) {
  messageInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const len = this.value.length;
    if (charCount) charCount.textContent = len;
    sendBtn.disabled = len === 0 || len > maxLength;
  });
}

// Envoyer un message
async function envoyerMessage() {
  const contenu = messageInput.value.trim();
  if (!contenu || contenu.length > maxLength) return;
  
  sendBtn.disabled = true;
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/forum/${forumId}/message/`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ contenu: contenu })
    });
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    if (data.success) {
      ajouterMessage(data.message);
      messageInput.value = '';
      if (charCount) charCount.textContent = '0';
      sendBtn.disabled = true;
      scrollToBottom();
    } else {
      alert(data.error || 'Erreur lors de l\'envoi');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Erreur:', error);
    alert('Erreur réseau');
  } finally {
    sendBtn.disabled = false;
    messageInput.focus();
  }
}

// Ajouter un message au DOM
function ajouterMessage(msg) {
  const isMyMessage = msg.auteur.id === {{ user.id }};
  const messageHtml = `
    <div class="forum-message ${isMyMessage ? 'my-message' : ''}" data-message-id="${msg.id}" data-auteur-id="${msg.auteur.id}">
      <div class="message-avatar">
        <div class="avatar-placeholder" style="background: ${['#1e3a8a','#3b82f6','#10b981','#f59e0b','#ef4444'][msg.auteur.id % 5]}">
          ${(msg.auteur.prenom || msg.auteur.username).charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="message-content">
        <div class="message-header">
          <span class="message-author">${escapeHtml(msg.auteur.prenom || msg.auteur.username)}</span>
          <span class="message-date">${msg.date_creation}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="message-body">${escapeHtml(msg.contenu).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>
        <div class="message-footer">
          <button class="message-signaler" data-message-id="${msg.id}" title="Signaler">
            <i class="fas fa-flag"></i> Signaler
          </button>
          {% if user.role == 'super_admin' or peut_moderer %}
          <button class="message-masquer" data-message-id="${msg.id}" data-auteur-id="${msg.auteur.id}" title="Masquer">
            <i class="fas fa-eye-slash"></i> Masquer
          </button>
          {% endif %}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  messagesDiv.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', messageHtml);
  
  if (msg.id > dernierMessageId) {
    dernierMessageId = msg.id;
  }
  
  attacherEvenementsMessages();
}

// Échapper le HTML
function escapeHtml(text) {
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = text;
  return div.innerHTML;
}

// Polling
async function verifierNouveauxMessages() {
  if (!pollingActif || enPause) return;
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/forum/${forumId}/messages/nouveaux/?dernier_id=${dernierMessageId}`);
    const data = await response.json();
    
    if (data.messages && data.messages.length > 0) {
      for (const msg of data.messages) {
        ajouterMessage(msg);
      }
      scrollToBottom();
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Erreur polling:', error);
  }
  
  timeoutId = setTimeout(verifierNouveauxMessages, intervallePolling * 1000);
}

// Signaler un message
async function signalerMessage(messageId) {
  if (!confirm('Signaler ce message ?')) return;
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/forum/message/signaler/${messageId}/`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
      }
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    alert(data.message || 'Message signalé');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Erreur:', error);
    alert('Erreur lors du signalement');
  }
}

// Masquer un message
async function masquerMessage(messageId) {
  if (!confirm('Masquer ce message ?')) return;
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/forum/message/masquer/${messageId}/`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ motif: 'Masqué par modérateur' })
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    if (data.success) {
      const msgDiv = document.querySelector(`.forum-message[data-message-id="${messageId}"]`);
      if (msgDiv) msgDiv.remove();
      alert('Message masqué');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Erreur:', error);
    alert('Erreur');
  }
}

function attacherEvenementsMessages() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.message-signaler').forEach(btn => {
    btn.removeEventListener('click', signalerHandler);
    btn.addEventListener('click', signalerHandler);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.message-masquer').forEach(btn => {
    btn.removeEventListener('click', masquerHandler);
    btn.addEventListener('click', masquerHandler);
  });
}

function signalerHandler(e) {
  const btn = e.currentTarget;
  const messageId = btn.dataset.messageId;
  signalerMessage(messageId);
}

function masquerHandler(e) {
  const btn = e.currentTarget;
  const messageId = btn.dataset.messageId;
  masquerMessage(messageId);
}

// Envoi avec Entrée
if (messageInput) {
  messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!sendBtn.disabled) envoyerMessage();
    }
  });
  
  sendBtn.addEventListener('click', envoyerMessage);
}

// Démarrer le polling
if (pollingActif) {
  verifierNouveauxMessages();
}

attacherEvenementsMessages();
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
    // Drag & Drop
    const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
    const fileInput = document.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
    const fileName = document.getElementById('fileName');

    dropZone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());

    dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropZone.style.borderColor = '#0d6efd';
        dropZone.style.background = '#f8faff';
    });

    dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
        dropZone.style.borderColor = '#d1d5db';
        dropZone.style.background = 'transparent';
    });

    dropZone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropZone.style.borderColor = '#d1d5db';
        dropZone.style.background = 'transparent';
        
        const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
        if (files.length > 0) {
            fileInput.files = files;
            fileName.textContent = files[0].name;
        }
    });

    fileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (fileInput.files.length > 0) {
            fileName.textContent = fileInput.files[0].name;
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
const CSRF     = '{{ csrf_token }}';
const USER_ID  = {{ user.id }};
const API_URL  = "{% url 'messagerie_api' %}";
const POLLING_ACTIF    = {{ messagerie_config.polling_actif|yesno:"true,false" }};
const POLLING_INTERVAL = {{ messagerie_config.intervalle_polling|default:30 }} * 1000;
const PAUSE_INACTIF    = {{ messagerie_config.pause_polling_onglet_inactif|yesno:"true,false" }};
{% if messagerie_config.pause_polling_apres_heure and messagerie_config.heure_debut_pause and messagerie_config.heure_fin_pause %}
const PAUSE_H_DEBUT = {{ messagerie_config.heure_debut_pause|date:"H" }};
const PAUSE_H_FIN   = {{ messagerie_config.heure_fin_pause|date:"H" }};
{% else %}
const PAUSE_H_DEBUT = null;
const PAUSE_H_FIN   = null;
{% endif %}

let convId      = null;
let pollingTimer = null;
let searchTimer  = null;
let autreAvatar  = null;

// ── Charger conversation ─────────────────────────────────────────
async function chargerConv(id, el) {
  convId = id;
  document.querySelectorAll('.msg-conv-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
  if (el) el.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('noConv').style.display = 'none';
  const activeConv = document.getElementById('activeConv');
  activeConv.style.display = 'flex';

  const res  = await api({action:'load', conv_id:id});
  const data = await res.json();
  if (data.error) return;

  const autre = data.autre_participant;
  autreAvatar = autre;

  // Header
  const avEl = document.getElementById('headerAvatar');
  avEl.innerHTML = autre.avatar
    ? `<img src="${autre.avatar}" alt="">`
    : `<span>${autre.nom.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('headerNom').textContent = autre.nom;

  afficherMessages(data.messages);
  demarrerPolling();

  // Effacer badge non lus
  const badge = document.querySelector(`[data-conv-id="${id}"] .msg-unread-count`);
  if (badge) badge.remove();
  const item = document.querySelector(`[data-conv-id="${id}"]`);
  if (item) item.dataset.nonLus = '0';
}

function afficherMessages(msgs) {
  const area = document.getElementById('messagesArea');
  if (!msgs.length) {
    area.innerHTML = `<div class="msg-search-empty" style="margin:auto;"><i class="fas fa-comment-dots fa-2x mb-2 d-block"></i>Aucun message. Dites bonjour !</div>`;
    return;
  }

  let html = '';
  let lastDate = '';
  msgs.forEach(msg => {
    const sent   = msg.expediteur_id === USER_ID;
    const wrap   = sent ? 'sent' : 'received';
    const init   = autreAvatar ? autreAvatar.nom.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : '?';
    const avHTML = (!sent) ? `<div class="msg-av-sm">${autreAvatar?.avatar ? `<img src="${autreAvatar.avatar}" alt="">` : init}</div>` : '';

    // Séparateur date
    const dateStr = msg.date_envoi;
    if (dateStr !== lastDate && dateStr.length > 5) {
      lastDate = dateStr;
    }

    html += `
    <div class="msg-bubble-wrap ${wrap}" data-msg-id="${msg.id}">
      ${avHTML}
      <div class="msg-bubble" ondblclick="copier('${escHtml(msg.contenu)}')">
        <div class="msg-bubble-actions">
          <button class="msg-action-btn" onclick="copier('${escHtml(msg.contenu)}')" title="Copier"><i class="fas fa-copy"></i></button>
          ${sent ? `<button class="msg-action-btn danger" onclick="supprimerMsg(${msg.id})" title="Supprimer"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${escHtml(msg.contenu)}
        <span class="msg-time">${msg.date_envoi}${msg.modifie ? ' · modifié' : ''}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  });

  area.innerHTML = html;
  area.scrollTop = area.scrollHeight;
}

// ── Envoyer message ──────────────────────────────────────────────
async function envoyerMsg() {
  const input = document.getElementById('msgInput');
  const txt   = input.value.trim();
  if (!txt || !convId) return;

  input.value = '';
  autoResize(input);

  const res  = await api({action:'send', conv_id:convId, contenu:txt});
  const data = await res.json();
  if (data.success) {
    playSendSound();
    await chargerConv(convId, document.querySelector(`[data-conv-id="${convId}"]`));
  }
}

async function supprimerMsg(msgId) {
  if (!confirm('Supprimer ce message ?')) return;
  await api({action:'delete_message', message_id:msgId});
  await chargerConv(convId, null);
}

async function marquerLu(id) {
  await api({action:'mark_read', conv_id:id});
  const badge = document.querySelector(`[data-conv-id="${id}"] .msg-unread-count`);
  if (badge) badge.remove();
  fermerTousMenus();
}

async function supprimerConv(id) {
  if (!confirm('Supprimer cette conversation pour vous ?')) return;
  const res  = await api({action:'delete', conv_id:id});
  const data = await res.json();
  if (data.success) location.reload();
}

async function viderConv() {
  if (!confirm('Vider tous les messages ?')) return;
  await api({action:'clear', conv_id:convId});
  await chargerConv(convId, null);
}

// ── Polling intelligent ──────────────────────────────────────────
function demarrerPolling() {
  if (pollingTimer) clearInterval(pollingTimer);
  if (!POLLING_ACTIF) return;

  pollingTimer = setInterval(async () => {
    // Pause si onglet inactif
    if (PAUSE_INACTIF && document.hidden) return;

    // Pause nocturne
    if (PAUSE_H_DEBUT !== null) {
      const h = new Date().getHours();
      if (h >= PAUSE_H_DEBUT || h < PAUSE_H_FIN) return;
    }

    if (!convId) return;

    try {
      const res  = await api({action:'poll', conv_id:convId});
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.has_new_messages) {
        await chargerConv(convId, document.querySelector(`[data-conv-id="${convId}"]`));
      }
    } catch(e) { /* serveur injoignable, on attend le prochain cycle */ }

  }, POLLING_INTERVAL);
}

// ── Recherche utilisateur (modal) ────────────────────────────────
function ouvrirNouveauMessage() {
    document.getElementById('newMsgModal').classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('userSearchInput').focus();
}

function fermerModal() {
    document.getElementById('newMsgModal').classList.remove('open');
    document.getElementById('userSearchResults').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('userSearchInput').value = '';
}

// Recherche en temps réel
document.getElementById('userSearchInput')?.addEventListener('input', function() {
    clearTimeout(searchTimer);
    const q = this.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
        document.getElementById('userSearchResults').innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }
    searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
            const res = await fetch("{% url 'messagerie_api' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': CSRF,
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: new URLSearchParams({
                    action: 'search_users',
                    search: q
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            const cont = document.getElementById('userSearchResults');
            
            if (!data.utilisateurs || data.utilisateurs.length === 0) {
                cont.innerHTML = `<div class="msg-search-empty">Aucun utilisateur trouvé</div>`;
                return;
            }
            
            cont.innerHTML = data.utilisateurs.map(u => `
                <div class="msg-user-result-item" onclick="demarrerConv(${u.id})">
                    <div class="msg-result-av">${u.avatar ? `<img src="${u.avatar}" alt="">` : u.nom.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</div>
                    <div class="msg-result-info">
                        <strong>${escapeHtml(u.nom)}</strong>
                        <span>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="msg-result-role">${escapeHtml(u.role || '')}</span>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Erreur recherche:', e);
        }
    }, 350);
});

// Démarrer une nouvelle conversation
async function demarrerConv(userId) {
    try {
        const res = await fetch("{% url 'messagerie_api' %}", {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
            },
            body: new URLSearchParams({
                action: 'new_conv',
                user_id: userId
            })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        
        if (data.conversation_id) {
            fermerModal();
            // CORRECTION ICI - Utiliser le bon nom d'URL
            window.location.href = `/messages/${data.conversation_id}/`;
        } else if (data.error) {
            showToast(data.error);
        }
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('Erreur création conversation:', e);
        showToast('Erreur lors de la création de la conversation');
    }
}

// Fonction pour échapper le HTML
function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
              .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
              .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
              .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

// Fonction pour afficher un toast
function showToast(msg) {
    const toast = document.getElementById('msgToast');
    if (toast) {
        toast.textContent = msg;
        toast.style.display = 'block';
        setTimeout(() => toast.style.display = 'none', 2000);
    } else {
        alert(msg);
    }
}

// ── Menus dropdown ───────────────────────────────────────────────
function toggleConvMenu(id, e) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  fermerTousMenus();
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu-' + id);
  if (menu) menu.style.display = menu.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
}
function fermerTousMenus() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.msg-conv-dropdown').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
}
document.addEventListener('click', fermerTousMenus);

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function copier(txt) {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);
  showToast('Message copié !');
}

function showToast(msg) {
  const t = document.getElementById('msgToast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 2000);
}

function escHtml(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return str.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
}

function playSendSound() {
  try {
    const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.frequency.value = 880;
    gain.gain.value = 0.08;
    osc.start();
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function autoResize(ta) {
  ta.style.height = 'auto';
  ta.style.height = Math.min(ta.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
}

async function api(data) {
  const fd = new FormData();
  Object.entries(data).forEach(([k,v]) => fd.append(k, v));
  return fetch(API_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF, 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
    body: fd
  });
}

function fermerConv() {
  document.getElementById('activeConv').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('noConv').style.display = 'flex';
  convId = null;
  if (pollingTimer) { clearInterval(pollingTimer); pollingTimer = null; }
}

// ── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('sendBtn')?.addEventListener('click', envoyerMsg);
document.getElementById('msgInput')?.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); envoyerMsg(); }
});
document.getElementById('msgInput')?.addEventListener('input', function() { autoResize(this); });

// Charger conv depuis URL
const urlConvId = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('conv_id');
if (urlConvId) {
  const el = document.querySelector(`[data-conv-id="${urlConvId}"]`);
  chargerConv(parseInt(urlConvId), el);
}
</script>

<script>
    const ressourceType = document.getElementById('ressourceType');
    const fichierFields = document.getElementById('fichierFields');
    const lienFields = document.getElementById('lienFields');
    
    function toggleRessourceFields() {
        if (ressourceType.value === 'fichier') {
            fichierFields.style.display = 'block';
            lienFields.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            fichierFields.style.display = 'none';
            lienFields.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
    
    ressourceType.addEventListener('change', toggleRessourceFields);
    toggleRessourceFields();
</script>

<script>
    const ressourceType = document.getElementById('ressourceType');
    const fichierFields = document.getElementById('fichierFields');
    const lienFields = document.getElementById('lienFields');
    
    function toggleRessourceFields() {
        if (ressourceType.value === 'fichier') {
            fichierFields.style.display = 'block';
            lienFields.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            fichierFields.style.display = 'none';
            lienFields.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
    
    ressourceType.addEventListener('change', toggleRessourceFields);
    toggleRessourceFields();
</script>

<script>
function showSection(id, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.config-section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.config-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById('section-' + id).classList.add('active');
    btn.classList.add('active');
}

// Confirmation avant sauvegarde
document.getElementById('configForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    const btn = this.querySelector('.btn-save');
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Enregistrement...';
    btn.disabled = true;
});
</script>

<script>
    function editRubrique(id, nom, ordre, actif) {
        document.getElementById('rubrique_id').value = id;
        document.getElementById('rubrique_nom').value = nom;
        document.getElementById('rubrique_ordre').value = ordre;
        document.getElementById('rubrique_actif').checked = actif;
        
        // Mettre à jour l'action du formulaire
        let form = document.querySelector('#modalRubriqueEdit form');
        form.action = "{% url 'admin_rubrique_modifier' 0 %}".replace('/0/', '/' + id + '/');
        
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('modalRubriqueEdit')).show();
    }
    
    function editCategorie(id, rubriqueId, nom, ordre, actif) {
        document.getElementById('categorie_id').value = id;
        document.getElementById('categorie_rubrique').value = rubriqueId;
        document.getElementById('categorie_nom').value = nom;
        document.getElementById('categorie_ordre').value = ordre;
        document.getElementById('categorie_actif').checked = actif;
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('modalCategorieEdit')).show();
    }
    
    function modifierSerie(code) {
        let url = "{% url 'admin_serie_modifier' 0 %}".replace('/0/', '/' + code + '/');
        window.location.href = url;
    }
    
    function supprimerSerie(code) {
        if(confirm('Supprimer cette série ?')) {
            let url = "{% url 'admin_serie_supprimer' 0 %}".replace('/0/', '/' + code + '/');
            window.location.href = url;
        }
    }
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
    // Auto-slug pour catégorie
    document.getElementById('categorie_nom')?.addEventListener('input', function() {
        const slugField = document.getElementById('categorie_slug');
        if(slugField && !slugField.value) {
            slugField.value = this.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
        }
    });
    
    // Auto-slug pour rubrique
    document.getElementById('rubrique_nom')?.addEventListener('input', function() {
        const slugField = document.getElementById('rubrique_slug');
        if(slugField && !slugField.value) {
            slugField.value = this.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
        }
    });
</script>

                        </div>

                            Le créateur reçoit le reste.
                        </small>
                    </div>

                        <h6 class="mb-2">Simulation</h6>
                        <p class="mb-1">Pour une formation à <strong id="simulationPrix">20 000</strong> FCFA :</p>
                        <p class="mb-0">
                            Commission plateforme : <strong id="simulationCommission">2 000</strong> FCFA<br>
                            Revenu créateur : <strong id="simulationCreateur">18 000</strong> FCFA
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    
                    <hr>

                        <a href="{% url 'super_admin_ecole_liste' %}" class="btn btn-secondary">Annuler</a>

<script>
    const commissionInput = document.querySelector('input[name="commission_pourcentage"]');
    const prixInput = document.getElementById('simulationPrix');
    
    function updateSimulation() {
        const commission = parseFloat(commissionInput.value) || 0;
        const prix = 20000;
        const montantCommission = (prix * commission) / 100;
        const montantCreateur = prix - montantCommission;
        
        document.getElementById('simulationCommission').textContent = Math.round(montantCommission);
        document.getElementById('simulationCreateur').textContent = Math.round(montantCreateur);
    }
    
    commissionInput.addEventListener('input', updateSimulation);
    updateSimulation();
</script>

{% endblock %}

FICHIER : .\website\templatetags\custom_filters.py
========================================

from django import template

register = template.Library()

@register.filter
def get_item(dictionary, key):
    """Récupère un élément d'un dictionnaire par sa clé"""
    if dictionary is None:
        return None
    return dictionary.get(key)

@register.filter
def get_attr(obj, attr):
    """Récupère un attribut d'un objet"""
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return getattr(obj, attr, None)

FICHIER : .\website\templatetags\messagerie_tags.py
========================================

from django import template
from ..models import MessagePrive

register = template.Library()

@register.simple_tag(takes_context=True)
def messages_non_lus(context):
    """Retourne le nombre de messages non lus pour l'utilisateur"""
    request = context.get('request')
    if not request or not request.user.is_authenticated:
        return 0
    
    return MessagePrive.objects.filter(
        conversation__participants=request.user,
        lu=False
    ).exclude(expediteur=request.user).count()

FICHIER : .\website\templatetags\seance_extras.py
========================================

from django import template

register = template.Library()

@register.filter
def get_item(dictionary, key):
    """Récupère une valeur d'un dictionnaire par sa clé"""
    if dictionary is None:
        return None
    try:
        return dictionary.get(key)
    except (AttributeError, TypeError):
        return None
